normalization: Whitespace runs collapse to one space and are trimmed; numbers print with up to ten decimals and no exponent; dates print as YYYY-MM-DD, date-times as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS and times as HH:MM:SS; booleans print as TRUE or FALSE; formula cells use their cached result. The checksum is SHA-256 over the JSON header array followed by one JSON array per data row holding the row number and every normalized cell, joined by line feeds.
